name: Web Development
description: Explores the design and implementation of web applications using modern frameworks like React and Next.js. Topics include client-side and server-side development, RESTful APIs, database integration with MongoDB, and deployment strategies.

name: Algorithms
description: A comprehensive study of algorithm design and analysis. Topics include dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graph algorithms, NP-completeness, and advanced data structures. Emphasis on problem-solving and computational complexity.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Covers the fundamentals of database systems including relational databases, SQL, normalization, transaction management, and NoSQL databases like MongoDB. Students will design and implement database applications.

name: Machine Learning
description: Introduction to machine learning algorithms and their applications. Topics include supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, decision trees, support vector machines, and deep learning fundamentals.

name: Software Engineering
description: Principles and practices of software engineering including software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, version control, testing strategies, design patterns, and team collaboration.

name: Computer Networks
description: Study of computer network architecture, protocols, and applications. Topics include TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, routing algorithms, network security, and wireless networks.

name: Mobile Application Development
description: Development of mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms. Covers mobile UI/UX design, native and cross-platform development, mobile databases, and integration with web services.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Exploration of cloud computing architectures, services, and deployment models. Topics include virtualization, containerization with Docker, serverless computing, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
